problems: The Elenchus prints no column beside any title; a detached block of 12 numbers (OCR lines 346-373) plus a lone '181' (line 446) are the only numbers. The 12-for-12 mapping (Cananus to Dialogus II) is inferred and cross-checked against the Ordo and the body; every bodyCol here rests on the body.

OCR duplication: pages 559-574 recur (lines 52371-53666 then 53795-54224), and pages 575-594 recur twice more (about lines 57157-60453); the Ordo header spells these ranges twice. First bodyLine given for every head; the 'ORATIO AD SUBDITOS' and 'PRECES MATUTINAE' heads each appear a second time (lines 53968, 54113). Also lines 5731-6095 (Notitia altera) and 102667-104986 (Phrantza cols 1011-1016) are repeated.
Items printed only inside the Fabricius Notitia altera (Dialogus cum matre, Epistola ad Andream Asan, Oratio Panegyrica) are footnotes there; the Panegyrica has no text in this volume at all.
Anagnosta's Vita (585) and Narratio (587) columns rest on the Ordo; the OCR page headers are missing between 585 and 589, so each is uncertain by up to 2 columns.

Elenchus lines 276-452 end with Phrantza's titles; the Elenchus omits Cananus' Notitia ex Warton (line 4235, col 59), Scitae sententiae (Ordo 307, line 28558), the Notitia/Vita pairs inside Chrysoloras (Ordo lists Vita ex Hankio 15 separately), Combefis' Monitum and Plethon's Protheoria (printed inside the Laudatio entry), Hasii Prolegomena, Romani editoris monitum and the 'Indices in Georgium Phrantzam' (Ordo ~1079). None entered.
